body:
Thanks @bobylito glad it's not a bug that is inherent. 

With the queryhook I was trying to implement the [second part](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/4#issuecomment-199319433) of #4 where the search hit list still has the results of the the last character that was deleted.

Implementing the one time flag works, although a desired behaviour would be to have the results return to blank (as like the initial state) if everything is deleted from the search box.
